patch_description: This design retains the graph-complete entanglement pattern that performed best in prior candidates while avoiding the parameter cost of a full second Euler layer. The fixed CZ on edge [3,5] is replaced by the recommended trainable CRX interaction, introducing an orthogonal conditional mixing channel. A shared post-entanglement RX layer then acts as a compact basis-changing echo: across repeated blocks, RX follows the initial RY/RZ transformations and creates richer noncommuting dynamics. Graph-aware parameter sharing keeps the model regularized at 132 total parameters, midway between the compact and high-performing deep candidates.
